definition: Cline is an open-source AI coding agent that operates through IDE extensions and a command-line interface.
details: It can inspect and modify source code, execute terminal commands, run tests, and perform other software development tasks from natural-language instructions. Cline supports models from multiple providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google, as well as locally hosted models through Ollama, LM Studio, and Atomic Chat.
story: Picture hiring a brilliant new assistant on their first morning — smart, motivated, but with no idea how anything in your office actually works. It plans a little, acts a little, looks at the result, and then decides what to do next. It is the difference between a search engine and a helper who actually finishes the task. It is a loop of look, act, and learn — the same way you cook from a recipe you have never tried: add, taste, correct. And that habit of checking, acting, then checking again is Cline (AI agent).
